description: Small, reversible increments with concise planning and targeted context
policy: Read project instructions and .workflow-kit/project.json before implementation.
Keep plans in chat for bounded work; persist decisions only when another session needs them.
Load only the current skill, relevant reference sections and affected code.
Use existing architecture and dependencies; deliver one coherent slice at a time.
Use test-first behavior changes and available quality gates; do not skip safety to save tokens.
Ask for missing product decisions and destructive actions; do not repeatedly reconfirm approved scope.
Summarize changed files, verification and remaining work concisely.
